note: Notes ride on soft-ignored actions (JSON has no comments); they never fail the run.
Loop before a playbook: wick snap URL --fast -> wick plan URL --fast -> wick ask URL --q 'terms'.
plan returns suggestions[] with ready-to-run cmd; ask filters links/elements by query words, no LLM.
Feed role= hints from snap/plan/ask into act steps below, e.g. click selector role=link[name="More information"].
For logins: wick vault suggest --url URL then wick act login URL. Fill is origin-bound; secrets never appear in JSON.
